newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex not seen consolidating Samper results.
newsitem.headline: Cemex not seen consolidating Samper results.

text.p: Cement maker Cemex is expected to not consolidate operations of its Colombian subsidiary Cementos Samper in its fourth quarter 1996 results, analysts said.
Cemex held a meeting with analysts last week, and one of those present told Reuters the company did not plan to consolidate Samper among earnings posted by its Colombian arm, Cementos Diamante.

"They said they will not consolidate Samper in their fourth quarter results, as they feel there is still room to raise efficiency at the plants, and they are working on that," said Gerardo Saenz, an analyst at the Serfin financial group.
Several analyst had feared that consolidating Samper could eat into Cemex's consolidated margin for 1996, which they see at 24 percent, or similar to that posted in 1995.
